Naya goal set karne ki koi umar nahi hoti.
Taqat sharir se nahi, majboot iraade se aati hai.
Solutions par dhyan do.
Motivation start karti, habit chalaaye rakhti.
Purpose se connected rehna motivation ka secret.
Apni choton ko gyaan mein badlo.
Jis person banna chahte, usi tarah act start karo.
"Comfort mat dhoondh; growth dhoondh."
Woh prajati jeevit nahi rehti jo sabse majboot hai, balki woh jo sabse aasaani se dhal jaati hai.
Mind hi sab kuch—jaisa sochte ho, vaisa bante ho.
Momentum tumhara dost hai.
